sources.feed_summary: Americans, you are so close to a break. You've reached the end of another week, and all you have to do now is pull your weight for the start of next week, and then the holiday season will kick off, and all our promises to not eat and drink so much will be tested, and, before you know it, you'll have to start thinking about your 2027 plans. But not yet! There's more time still, and today let's just take it easy, think not at all of everything that's about to transpire, and just consider some interesting watches together.
